exposure: Infant cord blood vitamin D metabolites (25(OH)D3, 24,25(OH)2D3, 3-epi-25(OH)D3)
outcome: Infant cord blood concentrations of 25(OH)D3, 24,25(OH)2D3, and 3-epi-25(OH)D3
Correlation between maternal and cord blood metabolite levels
cohort: The study included 131 mother-infant pairs at delivery.
finding: Maternal and cord vitamin D metabolite levels are highly correlated, but regulation of specific metabolites (like 3-epi-25(OH)D3, to which the fetus contributes significantly) may be mediated independently in mothers and neonates, and maternal/cord 25(OH)D3 concentrations were positively associated with birth weight.
birth_weight: Measured and found to be positively associated with maternal and cord 25(OH)D3 concentrations.
